title: Flappy Chonk: Absolute Unit Cat (Giant)
story: You are an absolute unit of a Persian cat and you have decided to fly through the living room. The cat tree was built for a normal cat. You are not a normal cat. You barely fit between the scratching posts, and you are judging all of them.
inspiration: Chonk-cat week on X: No Context Cats' one-word 'Chonk' post of a sprawled tabby and the 'so many thoughts so little brain' cat photos trending in Pets (X Trending 2117985852353589423 and 2117814161677926703, 4 Nov 2026). Archetype: Giant — 150px bird, 282 gap, slow 2.7 scroll: the cat barely fits. Bird = 'Watkin Fat Cat' Persian (Wikimedia Commons) cut with rembg; pillar = sisal scratching-post column from Commons 'XXL 4 Stamm Kratzbaum von CATHOME' cut with rembg plus a carpeted platform cap; sky = Commons cozy living room photo.
